description:
cargo audit fails every CI run on RUSTSEC-2026-0344 (ruzstd 0.8.3 decompression bomb, high, filed 2026-10-11). ruzstd, with flate2, miniz_oxide, adler2, simd-adler32 and twox-hash, reaches fz only through object 0.39's default 'compression' feature. fz never decompresses object data: its only object read is object::File::parse in a drive_test (compiler2_typed_kernel_arithmetic_helpers_call_real_pair_exports_in_the_native_path). cranelift-object already depends on object with default-features = false.

Change: object = { version = "0.39", default-features = false, features = ["read", "std", "write"] }.

Acceptance: cargo tree -i ruzstd finds nothing; cargo audit passes in CI; the full gate passes.
title: Nothing we ship carries a decompressor we never use
